def resample_route(route_rc: np.ndarray, spacing_px: float = 2.5) -> np.ndarray:
    delta = np.diff(route_rc, axis=0)
    lengths = np.hypot(delta[:, 0], delta[:, 1])
    distance = np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(lengths)))
    if distance[-1] < 1e-6:

    samples = np.arange(0.0, distance[-1], spacing_px)
    if samples.size == 0 or distance[-1] - samples[-1] > 0.25 * spacing_px:

    rows = np.interp(samples, distance, route_rc[:, 0])
